summary: Mr. Arking discusses whether the final word of the twelfth blessing of the Amida should be Zedim or Minim. He reviews early sources, the opinion of the Hida, and the varying customs and texts used in Halab and in Brooklyn.
questions: What is the difference between saying Zedim and Minim in the Amida?
Which early sources support the word Zedim?
Why did the Hida rule that the last word should be Minim?
What was the custom regarding Zedim and Minim in Halab?
